vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin NMD --plugin Faulty --plugin pLI,{corpus}/plugin_data/pLI_values.txt [--tab|--vcf|--json]
generator: variants.vcf and json_cache: the GRCh38-plugin-nmd corpus's records and its pruned cache (scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice of the vep-rs JSON conversion of the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache), copied as they are; manifest: that corpus's manifest with this corpus's flags, covers, plugin_files, masks and reference_warnings; plugins/Faulty.pm: the Ensembl VEP module the reference run loads from --dir_plugins {plugins}, mounted by the generator's --dir-plugins; plugin_data/pLI_values.txt: the rows of the pLI plugin's bundled pLI_values.txt for the genes the records' transcript rows name, the directory vep-rs reads as {plugins}; expected outputs and this record: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus tests/golden/116/GRCh38-plugin-faulty --dir-plugins tests/golden/116/GRCh38-plugin-faulty/plugins --perl-cache-dir <full Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache> (NMD and pLI read from the image's /plugins through PERL5LIB), the warnings file kept beside each format as expected/<format>.warnings.log
